executive_summary.text: On 2026-11-18, a brute-force attack targeted Finance analyst account j.mehta on the critical internet-exposed host fin-app-01. Source IP 203.0.113.77 (external, not in j.mehta's baseline) made 50 failed SSH authentication attempts between 09:31:02 and 09:41:55 UTC, followed by a successful authentication at 09:42:17 UTC. No sudo or account change activity was observed post-login. An outbound TCP session to 198.51.100.23:443 was recorded 48 minutes later. IP reputation and the outbound session's purpose are unknown. Severity is high due to brute-force success on a high-criticality, internet-exposed host; confidence is medium due to unknowns regarding IP reputation and post-login activity.
